<strong>U.S. Freight Transportation Analytics</strong>
<p> Analyzed 599,529 U.S. freight records from the Bureau of Transportation Statistics' Freight Analysis Framework (FAF6) to identify freight volume, economic value, transportation-mode patterns, state-level concentration, and high-value commodities. </p> <p> <strong>Tools:</strong> R • Tableau • Excel • Git </p> <p> <strong>Data Source:</strong> U.S. Bureau of Transportation Statistics </p> <div class="project-buttons">

<div class="featured-project">
<strong>Natural Language Next-word Prediction Model</strong>
<p>A natural language next-word prediction model accompanied by an app which predicts the most likely next word when a user enters a word or a sentence; the same category of "invisible AI" behind phone keyboards, search auto-complete, and drafting assistants entirely from raw text, with no external APIs or pre-trained language models. </p> <p> <strong>Tools:</strong> R • Shiny • GitHub • Git </p> <p> <strong>Data Source:</strong> Swiftkey/Coursera </p> <div class="project-buttons">
